summary: fractal-test-test's pool-queue test waits for the waiter's third look instead of a fixed 0.6 s, so a waiter thread scheduled late on a loaded host no longer fails it.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no stored data is read or written.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: scripts/st-test is unchanged; only its test changes.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; the test then fails when its waiter is scheduled late.
